# Harbour exhibit: the Quay photographs

- We plan to print six photographs from the county archive's Quay Collection at A1 size for the panels: QC-014, QC-022, QC-031, QC-040, QC-047 and QC-052.
- The exhibit is in St Brannoc's Hall from 12 to 14 December 2026. Entry is free.
- We have the 300 dpi scans that the archive put on its website. We have no letter or licence about printing them.
- Our contact at the archive is Dilys Penhale, the reading-room manager (`reading-room@countyarchive.example`).
